subject: Math
text_verbatim: Skill Sharpener 1. Colour the box for the given position. 11th [20 blank circles] 19th [20 blank circles] 15th [20 blank circles] 20th [20 blank circles] 17th [20 blank circles] 2. Circle the correct ordinal number. fifteenth 15th 11th 19th sixteenth 20th 17th 16th seventeenth 14th 17th 18th eighteenth 18th 19th 20th 3. Read the instructions and fill in the boxes. a. Colour the fourth, eighteenth and twentieth box red. b. Colour the nineteenth, thirteenth and fourteenth box blue. c. Put a happy face in the first, sixth and sixteenth box. d. Put a red X on the seventeenth and fifteenth box. e. Colour the second, third and fifth box green. f. Put a red + in the seventh and ninth box. g. Put two happy faces in the eight and tenth box. 23

exercises.label: Question 1 — Colour the box for the given position
exercises.instruction_verbatim: Colour the box for the given position.
exercises.answer_key: In each row, colour the single circle at the position named by the row label, counting left-to-right from the 1st circle: row '11th' -> colour circle #11; row '19th' -> colour circle #19; row '15th' -> colour circle #15; row '20th' -> colour circle #20 (the last circle in the row); row '17th' -> colour circle #17.
exercises.count_method: 300dpi-crop, horizontal-scanline edge-detection at 2 independent y-offsets per row (dark-pixel rising-edge count / 2)

exercises.label: Question 2 — Circle the correct ordinal number
Question 3 — Read the instructions and fill in the boxes (a-g)
exercises.instruction_verbatim: Read the instructions and fill in the boxes. a. Colour the fourth, eighteenth and twentieth box red. b. Colour the nineteenth, thirteenth and fourteenth box blue. c. Put a red + in the seventh and ninth box. g. Put two happy faces in the eight and tenth box.
items: a-g instructions, no boxes printed on this page
exercises.answer_key: The 20-box answer grid for this question is printed on the NEXT page (printed 24, top of page) as a 5-column x 4-row grid of boxes numbered 1-20 in reading order (row1=1-5, row2=6-10, row3=11-15, row4=16-20). Mapping instructions a-g onto that grid: a. red = boxes 4,18,20. b. blue = boxes 19,13,14. c. happy face = boxes 1,6,16. d. red X = boxes 17,15. e. green = boxes 2,3,5. f. red + = boxes 7,9. g. two happy faces = boxes 8,10.
